Room.title: Room
Room.description: A real-time messaging room identified by a unique room ID.

name.description: Display name of the chat room.

createdBy.description: UID of the user who created the room.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the room was created.

lastMessage.description: Content preview of the most recent message.

lastMessageSender.description: Display name of the user who sent the latest message.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: An instant message sent within a specific room.

id.description: Unique identifier for the message document.

roomId.description: ID of the parent room this message belongs to.

senderName.description: Display name or alias of the message sender.

clientId.description: Client session or tab ID to distinguish multi-window sessions.

text.description: Message body text, either plaintext or end-to-end encrypted payload.

isEncrypted.description: Flag indicating if the text is encrypted with the room key.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Collection of active chat rooms identified by room ID.

/rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time messages sent within the chat room.
